name: regulatory
description: Regulatory applicability, examinations, licences, change, filings, and sanctions-screening skills.

interface.longDescription: Six reusable regulatory workflows covering applicability, examinations and show-cause responses, licences, change monitoring, filings, and reproducible sanctions screening.
defaultPrompt: Identify the current regulatory framework for this activity and document what remains unverified.
Prepare this regulatory response, licence application, or filing from authoritative requirements and evidence.
Document this sanctions screening or regulatory change review as a reproducible audit record.
